description: Prepared scalar inputs of the massless-quark QCD ladder self-energy rungs (the rung fixture of tests/ordered_reduction_rungs.rs). Each input is the fixture's vakint-input.symbolica; its sha256 equals the rung reference's source_input_sha256, which the rung test checks against a fresh native preparation. retained_sha256 is the sha256 of the retained-master result's canonical string (MSbar, retain mode, dot-product notation, L+1 epsilon terms), identical for every arithmetic and n_cores.
external_data: vakint-external-data v0.1.2 (f1626f67) for the recorded values
recorded_scope: one release-build run of the rung test on the development host, n_cores 4, modular_polynomial (2026-10-31); indicative, not a benchmark

3L-zero-momentum.label: 3L ladder · zero momentum
3L-zero-momentum.conventions:
Native model-rule-generated massless QCD quark loop with 2 gluon rungs; fixed SU(3), tr_Dirac(1)=4, generic Lorentz dimension d.
Both external current vertices retained; unaveraged g_munu*delta_ab contraction at q=0.
No transverse projector, no division by 8(d-1), and no auxiliary angular integration.
L=3, original A=8, 6 vacuum incidence edges, 5 distinct quadratic forms.
Unlowered D_source=A-r_mom=5; omega_UV(d=4)=2.
Common UV mass inserted only into denominators; original slash numerators remain massless.
Not a complete beta function. Verified saved scalar inputs separate preparation from IBP timing.

3L-quadratic.label: 3L ladder · quadratic Taylor coefficient
3L-quadratic.conventions:
Native model-rule-generated massless QCD quark loop with 2 gluon rungs; fixed SU(3), tr_Dirac(1)=4, generic Lorentz dimension d.
Complete homogeneous quadratic Taylor coefficient of numerator AND denominators.
Transverse contraction delta_ab*(g_munu-q_mu*q_nu/q^2)/[8*(d-1)*q^2]; normalized auxiliary angular average at fixed q^2.
L=3, original A=8, 6 vacuum incidence edges, 5 distinct quadratic forms.
Unlowered D_source=A-r_mom=6; omega_UV(d=4)=0.
Common UV mass inserted only into denominators; original slash numerators remain massless.
Not a complete beta function. Verified saved scalar inputs separate preparation from IBP timing.
